name: Vitalspan: Recovery Coach
subtitle: Recovery, Strain & Body Age
promotionalText: Turn your Fitbit or Pixel Watch data into a daily Recovery score, Strain target, personal Sleep Need and a research-based Body Age. Private: data stays on your phone.
description:
Vitalspan turns the data your Fitbit or Google Pixel Watch already records into clear daily coaching: how recovered you are, how hard to train, how much sleep you need, and how your habits are shaping your long-term health.

RECOVERY
Every morning you get a 0–100% Recovery score built from heart rate variability, resting heart rate while asleep, breathing rate, skin temperature, blood oxygen and sleep, each compared with your own 30-night baseline. Green, yellow or red tells you at a glance whether to push or recover.

STRAIN
Day Strain measures cardiovascular load from your heart rate on a 0–21 scale, with strain for every workout and a daily Strain Target based on your recovery.

SLEEP
A personal Sleep Need that adds time after hard days and short nights, Sleep Performance with efficiency, consistency and stages, and a bedtime planner with optional wind-down reminders.

BODY AGE & PACE OF AGING
Nine habits linked to longevity in large population studies, including sleep consistency, steps, cardio zones, strength training, VO2 max and resting heart rate, are combined into a research-based Body Age. Pace of Aging shows whether your last 30 days are moving it in the right direction. Every factor shows how many years it adds or subtracts and what to aim for.

MORE
• Stress: a 0–3 score from heart rate against your 14-day baseline, with workouts filtered out
• Health Monitor: overnight vitals against your personal normal range
• Trends over 30, 90 and 180 days
• Journal: log habits and see which ones raise or lower your recovery
• Your tracker: what your device measures, its published accuracy, and exactly how Vitalspan adapts to it

BUILT FOR YOUR TRACKER
Works with Fitbit trackers and Google Pixel Watch through the Google Health API (sign in with the Google account your device uses). Vitalspan adapts to each device. For example, it uses deep-sleep HRV where available, resting heart rate measured during sleep, and leaves out estimates a device can't measure well. Each score shows a confidence level. No device? Try the full app with demo data, or import a Fitbit export file.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your health data travels directly from Google to your iPhone and is processed only on your device. We never receive it. Delete everything with one tap.

IMPORTANT
Vitalspan is a wellness app, not a medical device. It does not diagnose or treat any condition. Scores are estimates from consumer wearable data and published research. Vitalspan is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google or Fitbit. Fitbit and Pixel Watch are trademarks of Google LLC.
